sections.title: Why research at an app company

items.q: Why not just wait for the next frontier model?
items.a: Because users need it now, and **in-house know-how** lets you **hit the ground running** when APIs catch up.

items.q: What happened to Ramp's LLM unit costs as usage grew?
items.a: Use cases grew **123%**, yet features got **cheaper per unit** as models improved.

items.q: Where was Opus 4.6 slow in Ramp Sheets?
items.a: **Researching many spreadsheets** before building models like a DCF.

items.q: What did the post-trained Qwen 3.5 35B achieve?
items.a: It **beat Opus 4.6** on financial QA accuracy at **Haiku-level latency**.

items.q: Who stays in charge of the task?
items.a: The **frontier model as orchestrator**; the specialist is a **fast tool** it calls.
Context **compressed 20-30x into the KV cache offline**, built before the user starts.

items.q: What did 10,000 parallel agents find at Ramp?
items.a: **7 high-severity vulnerabilities**, including a cross-component **Lua script injection**.

items.q: Can cheaper models work in a swarm?
items.a: Yes: open models **up to 5x cheaper** gave nearly the **same detection rate**.
